signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to your church’s ChuFlow workspace.

recovery.requestHint: Enter your sign-in email to request a reset link.
recovery.resetHint: Copy the reset link from your email and paste it here to finish in ChuFlow.
recovery.doneHint: Sign in with your new password.
recovery.sent: If there’s an account for this email, check your inbox for a reset link.
recovery.invalidLink: Paste the full ChuFlow reset link from your email.
recovery.expiredLink: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
recovery.sendFailed: Couldn’t request a reset email. Try again.
recovery.resetFailed: Couldn’t reset your password. Try again.
